newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Infratil,NZ Post bid for Argentine post concession.
newsitem.headline: Infratil,NZ Post bid for Argentine post concession.

text.p: Infratil International said on Thursday it had agreed with New Zealand Post to jointly bid for an Argentina postal concession.
It said the Argentine government was tendering a 30 year concession for its national postal service ENCOTESA. Pre-qualifying bids are due in early June, 1997.
This represented the world's first privatisation of a national postal service on a concession basis, Infratil International said.

"The New Zealand Post and Infratil International are undertaking this initiative with a small group of significant Argentine companies, who have the capability to develop synergistic opportunities with postal services, including banking, insurance and telephony," Infratil International said.
It said ENCOTESA has a turnover of US$487 million but makes a loss of US$23 million. It processed 464 million items of mail and had 20,000 staff.
"New Zealand Post processes twice as many mail items with half as many staff."
Infratil International said its relationship with New Zealand Post illustrated its intention to pursue international opportunities with leading infrastructure operators.

Infratil International, which plans to list on the New Zealand Stock Exchange next month, is managed by New Zealand-based merchant bankers Morrison & Co, who also manage Infratil NZ Ltd and are specialist advisers to the infrastructure and utilities sector.
